content:
anya: Quick async check — stitchboard milestone review. One message per person: what actually shipped this quarter, what slipped, and top 1-2 next actions + owner. Trying to get a compact rollup for execs by EOD Friday.

mike: Shipped: routing-policy PR merged + canary for model-routing-v1 (10% traffic). Perf looks stable.

claire: Shipped: milestone docs and rollout plan for billing alerts. Worked with finance to add 7-day burn watch.

lee: Shipped: dedicated autoscale policy v2 (config UI + infra hooks). Still testing burst behavior under 50ms SLA.

sofia: Slipped: private deploy K8s operator — blocked on cert rotation bug in customer envs. Root cause suspected cert issuer mismatch.

mike: Slipped: KV cache eviction fix regressed in long-seq perf test. Reverted to prev version, diagnostics in progress.

dan: Shipped: Optimize suggestions engine MVP (internal) for batching recommendations. Needs docs before public.

anya: Action roundup: please state 1 owner + ETA for next step. I’ll compile into the stitchboard rollup.

mike: Owner: mike — KV cache diag + temporary patch. ETA: 48 hrs. Plan: run perf smoke on range 1k-8k seqs, then patch.

sofia: Owner: sofia + infra — cert rotation triage. ETA: 3 business days. Workaround: manual rotation for affected customers (doc updated).

lee: Owner: lee — autoscale burst test + tweak. ETA: 36 hrs. If tail latency spikes, we rollback config.

claire: Owner: claire — billing alert docs -> publish and add runbook. ETA: EOD Wednesday.

dan: Owner: dan — docs for optimize suggestions + one-pager for devex. ETA: Friday.

mike: Note: canary traffic shaped to minimize cost impact, keeping legacy route as fallback. Tagging @claire for billing watchers.

anya: Two cross-deps spotted: 1) docs for optimize must land before public PR (dan -> claire). 2) autoscale config may affect canary routing (lee -> mike). Please ack if you own the handoff.

claire: Acknowledged dan -> claire doc handoff. I’ll add to publish checklist.

lee: Acknowledged lee -> mike handoff. I’ll post the test results and a small config diff.

release-bot: Deploy report: model-routing-v1 canary started 1768149800, 10% -> stable metrics at 1768150500.

anya: OK — final asks: mike & sofia verify ETAs in 24 hrs, post a short update here. I’ll stitch into the Qtr milestone summary. Thanks all :thumbsup:

mike: Will update in ~24h.

sofia: Will update — starting triage now.
